values.quickstart:
nix shell 'github:nix-purifiers/terraform-purifier'
terraform-purifier lock
terraform-purifier prefetch
terraform init
terraform validate
terraform plan
values.language_tooling_setup:
Start `terraform-ls serve` from the same shell. Prefetch supplies the language
server, provider binaries, schemas available from those binaries, and Git
module sources. Native cache metadata lets definition lookup reach the
locked modules. The editor check verifies that lookup in the Nix sandbox.
